exposure_statement: This campaign is exploratory development on repeatedly used Adult people. Source models already trained on all FIT. The previous FIT2 validation outcomes and study-level results are exposed. This successor was designed in light of those failures. Excluding FIT2 from this continuation's optimization does not make it fresh confirmation. Intervals are conditional on the fitted models and readers and do not account for the full adaptive research history.

F1_nonzero_J_TRUST_checkpoint_passes_bot.reason: KL<=0.001 keeps the function near the start, but seed-0 FIT2 occupation headroom vs U0 is only ~0.0044 NLL and ~0.0023 Brier, so modest held-out drift could still break a clause.

F2_trust_improves_heldout_utility_relati.reason: J_FREE can spend the full +0.004 fitting NLL budget on privacy-driven changes that generalize worse, while the KL anchor limits that movement.

F3_J_TRUST_beats_RAW_PROJ_by_required_co.reason: A 325-parameter correction confined to KL<=0.001 is unlikely to cut coalition AUC by a simultaneously-bounded >0.020 when predictions themselves carry most of the signal.

F4_J_TRUST_beats_strongest_eligible_loca.reason: Coupling the pair critic adds little when income is frozen and rank one; local and joint adapters should move similarly within the same trust region.

F5_old_GLOBAL_UPDATE_GUARD_lowers_indepe.reason: Its accepted updates changed occupation predictions and its own critics, but fresh nonlinear readers on the complete hybrid wire usually recover what training critics miss; a simultaneously established reduction is unlikely.

adapter_contract.occupation: z_release = (q0 + hbar64 R^T + b_res) B with q0 = float64(z0) B^T; frozen folded own head outputs

recipe.finite_acceptance: recompute full-pool NLL, Brier, correct (and K for TRUST) after real update; NLL/Brier/K <= limit + 1e-10

recipe.income: bitwise frozen factorized RAW income projection; checked after every update and in every wire
recipe.no_sweeps: no lambda, KL, temperature, capacity, head architecture, mask, calibration, controller or refitted-critic family

normalization.unavailable_if: median nonfinite or <=1e-12, or coefficient > 1e4; recorded, no search

recipe.qp: min ||d-p||^2 s.t. g_NLL.d<=s_NLL, g_Brier.d<=s_Brier, [g_K.d<=s_K for TRUST], ||d||<=0.01; exact KKT active-set enumeration
